title: 4 Kingdoms. 1 Island. Who Rules It? 👑
description:
Frostmere, Verdance, Rosegarde and Sunspire wake on the same island. Every order is a drag across the map; every territory is a fight. Who rules the island at the bell? Call it in the comments before the end!

A 60-second territory war simulation on The Ashen Coast. Every territory grows troops; each kingdom drags its armies across its borders to capture the land next door, and armies that meet head-on on a road cancel out. Four kingdoms, one island: the kingdom with the most land at the bell wins, unless one takes it all first. The outcome comes from the game's rules and chance, not real footage, and the kingdoms are made up.

Kingdoms in this battle: Frostmere ❄️, Verdance 🌳, Rosegarde 🌹, Sunspire ☀️.

New territory wars 4 times a day: subscribe so you don't miss the next one.
